verses.gurmukhi: ਜੈਸੇ ਅਹਿ ਨਿਸ ਅੰਧਿਆਰੀ ਮਣਿ ਕਾਢਿ ਰਾਖੈ ਕ੍ਰੀੜਾ ਕੈ ਦੁਰਾਵੈ ਪੁਨਿ ਕਾਹੂ ਨ ਦਿਖਾਵਹੀ ॥
verses.translit_en: jaise eh nis a(n)dhiaaree man kaadd raakhai kreeRaa kai dhuraavai pun kaahoo na dhikhaavahee ||

en.bdb: Just as during dark nights, snake takes out its jewel, plays around with it and then hides it and does not show to anyone.

verses.gurmukhi: ਜੈਸੇ ਬਰ ਨਾਰਿ ਕਰਿ ਸਿਹਜਾ ਸੰਜੋਗ ਭੋਗ ਹੋਤ ਪਰਭਾਤ ਤਨ ਛਾਦਨ ਛੁਪਾਵਹੀ ॥
verses.translit_en: jaise bar naar kar sihajaa sa(n)jog bhog hot parabhaat tan chhaadhan chhupaavahee ||

en.bdb: Just as a virtuous wife enjoys the pleasure of the company of her husband at night and as the day breaks, re-drapes herself.

verses.gurmukhi: ਜੈਸੇ ਅਲਿ ਕਮਲ ਸੰਪਟ ਅਚਵਤ ਮਧ ਭੋਰ ਭਏ ਜਾਤ ਉਡ ਨਾਤੋ ਨ ਜਨਾਵਹੀ ॥
verses.translit_en: jaise al kamal sa(n)paT achavat madh bhor bhe jaat udd naato na janaavahee ||

en.bdb: Just as a bumble bee closed in the box-like lotus flower keep sucking the sweet elixir and flies away in the morning as soon as the flower blooms again without acknowledging any relationship with it.

verses.gurmukhi: ਤੈਸੇ ਗੁਰਸਿਖ ਉਠ ਬੈਠਤ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਜੋਗ ਸਭ ਸੁਧਾ ਰਸ ਚਾਖਿ ਸੁਖ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਾਵਹੀ ॥੫੬੮॥
verses.translit_en: taise gursikh uTh baiThat a(n)mirat jog sabh sudhaa ras chaakh sukh tirapataavahee ||568||

en.bdb: Similarly, an obedient disciple of the True Guru absorbs himself in the meditation of the Lord's name and feels satiated and blissful relishing the elixir like Naam. (But he does not mention his blissful state of the ambrosial hour to anyone).  (568)
